It is keyed by authentication provider id (authenticationAccessService.ts:51); without an entry matching provider.default.id the extension gets a consent prompt for its own product's account on first use. Turns off the experimental welcome page. Its sign-in button label is a literal "Continue with GitHub" and the provider it signs into is a hardcoded 'github' (onboardingVariationA.ts:707), while the surrounding terms text correctly reads Novel Builder because that part comes from product.json. On this product it therefore signs into a provider that does not exist, which is what produced two disagreeing states: an account menu showing a valid Novel Builder session and a chat surface insisting the user is signed out. Upstream holds nothing at this key.
